result.description: REDEEM SKILLS RECRUITMENT SOLUTIONS   REDEEM SKILLS RECRUITMENT SOLUTIONS (RECRUITER) on behalf of   Rushlee Pty Ltd  ,   Geelong VIC 3220   Join Rushlee as a Systems Administrator, where you will be responsible for maintaining and supporting the organisation's IT infrastructure, networks, servers, and business systems to ensure secure, reliable, and efficient operations. The role involves monitoring system performance, troubleshooting technical issues, managing user access, implementing cybersecurity measures, and supporting technology upgrades. This position is integral to maintaining business continuity, enhancing operational efficiency, and providing a stable technology environment that supports Rushlee's workforce and ongoing business growth.   Benefits   Competitive remuneration   Full-time, stable employment with a growing, locally owned business  Supportive team environment with a focus on safety and professionalism    Task & responsibilities   Install, configure, administer, and maintain the organisation's servers, operating systems, business applications, cloud platforms, and network infrastructure to ensure reliable and secure operations.  Monitor the performance, availability, and security of IT systems and networks, proactively identifying and resolving issues to minimise downtime.  Manage user accounts, access permissions, email services, and authentication controls in accordance with organisational security policies.  Provide technical support to employees by diagnosing and resolving hardware, software, network, and system-related issues in a timely manner.  Implement, maintain, and monitor cybersecurity measures, including firewalls, endpoint protection, system updates, backups, and disaster recovery processes to safeguard organisational data.  Perform routine system maintenance, software upgrades, security patching, and configuration management to optimise system performance and reliability.  Administer and maintain databases, data storage solutions, and backup systems to ensure data integrity, availability, and secure information management.  Develop and maintain IT documentation, system configurations, operational procedures, and asset registers to support effective system administration.  Liaise with external technology vendors and service providers to coordinate system maintenance, software licensing, technical support, and infrastructure upgrades.  Support and maintain business technology including workstations, mobile devices, telecommunications systems, printers, and remote access solutions.  Assist management in planning, implementing, and improving IT infrastructure and technology solutions that enhance operational efficiency and support business growth.  Ensure all IT systems and practices comply with organisational policies, privacy obligations, cybersecurity standards, and other applicable regulatory requirements.    Qualification & experience   Bachelor degree or higher qualification in Information Technology, Computer Science, Network Administration, Systems Administration, or a related field.  Minimum 1 year of full-time relevant work experience (or equivalent part-time/casual experience) in systems administration, IT support, or network administration.  Demonstrated experience administering Windows Server, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, cloud platforms, and business IT systems.  Sound knowledge of networking technologies, including TCP/IP, DNS, VPNs, routers, switches, and wireless networks.  Experience managing system security, backups, disaster recovery, and software updates.  Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills across hardware, software, and network environments.  Excellent organisational, communication, and time management skills.  Ability to work independently and collaboratively while providing technical support to end users.  Knowledge of information security, data privacy, and compliance requirements, with healthcare or community services experience being advantageous.   About Company     Rushlee Pty Ltd is a Geelong-based information technology company specialising in network infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud networking, IT support, and system administration services. The company provides reliable and secure technology solutions to businesses across various industries. With a strong focus on innovation, network performance, and customer service, Rushlee Pty Ltd supports the design, maintenance, monitoring, and enhancement of business-critical IT systems and network environments. Job description:

 
Join a supportive team and help ensure the accuracy and integrity of Tasmania's health information systems. Use your attention to detail to resolve data issues, improve record quality, and support reliable patient information across the health service.

 

 






 

The Team

This position is part of a small, supportive team that works closely together to deliver high-quality health information and administrative services. Team members are encouraged to share knowledge, support one another, and contribute ideas to continually improve processes and service delivery. The role offers the opportunity to work collaboratively while also exercising initiative and autonomy in day-to-day responsibilities.

The Role

Participate in the day to day identification, review and management of potential duplicate records according to documented processes.

Merge identified duplicate records in the PAS, ensuring that associated data in downstream systems attached to the Tasmanian Health Client Index (THCI) are handled appropriately, including provision of merge notification to System Administrators where necessary.

Run reports which support the management of the identification systems and assist users in resolving data integrity problems.

You will need

Knowledge and practical experience in medical records management, including the use of computerised health information systems.

High level interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to show initiative and discretion, and maintain confidentiality.

Experience in the use of various software packages for the production of reports, spreadsheets and databases, with the ability to undertake analysis of data and reports, and the ability to learn new software applications.

Note: - Please refer to the Statement of Duties for all the selection criteria of this position to address in your application.

Details of appointment

Fixed term full time, day worker position, working 76 hours per fortnight, commencing as soon as possible up to 6 months.

*Notwithstanding hours to be negotiated with the successful applicant.

Applicants should note that, for a period of twelve months from the date of publication, this selection process may be used to fill subsequent or similar full time, part time, and casual vacancies.

Salary

$76,849 to $82,996 per annum. Our Employer 12% superannuation contribution is on top of this amount.

Salary range is in accordance with Public Sector Unions Wages Agreement 2025.

Benefits available to eligible candidates

A range of leave entitlements, including study leave and Professional Development Support.

Fitness Passport - You, and your family can access 40+ fitness facilities across Tasmania for just $14.50 per week per person, or $28.05 for a family.

More information about our Employee Benefits can be found here

PERSOL  is seeking an experienced Project Manager - Electrical to lead the delivery of a major renewable energy infrastructure project.    The role will commence with approximately 6 months in Perth, working within the Major Projects Study Team to develop project scope, execution strategy and delivery plans before transitioning to site for the execution phase (approximately 12 months). During construction, candidates must be flexible to work a 2/2 FIFO roster if required.    This is an opportunity to manage a project from concept and study through to construction, commissioning and handover.     The Opportunity     As Project Manager, you will take ownership of project delivery across safety, commercial performance, schedule, quality and stakeholder management, working closely with engineering, construction and client teams to ensure successful project outcomes.     Key Responsibilities    
 
 Lead project planning and execution from study phase through construction and commissioning 
 Manage project budgets, forecasts, schedules and commercial performance 
 Oversee procurement activities, contractor management and contract administration 
 Coordinate civil, structural and electrical construction activities 
 Ensure compliance with safety, environmental and quality requirements 
 Build strong relationships with clients, engineering teams, utilities, regulators and key stakeholders 
 Identify project risks and implement mitigation strategies 
 Monitor project progress and drive schedule performance 
 Manage subcontractors, suppliers and major equipment deliveries 
 Oversee reporting, change management, RFIs and project documentation 
 Support commissioning, grid connection and operational handover 
 
  About You      To be successful you will have:    
 
 Degree in Electrical Engineering, Construction Management or a related discipline 
 7+ years' experience managing major infrastructure, power or renewable energy projects 
 Proven experience delivering projects through the full lifecycle from study through execution 
 Strong knowledge of EPC contract delivery, procurement and commercial management 
 Experience using MS Project, Primavera P6 or similar scheduling software 
 Excellent leadership, stakeholder management and communication skills 
 Strong financial management, budgeting and forecasting capability 
 Flexibility to transition to a FIFO roster during the construction phase 
 
  Highly Regarded    
 
 Experience delivering Solar PV, BESS, transmission or other renewable energy projects 
 PMP or equivalent Project Management qualification 
 Experience with Procore or similar construction management systems 
 
  What's on Offer    
 
 Initial Perth-based role working within the Major Projects Study Team 
 Transition to site for approximately 12 months during execution 
 Opportunity to lead a significant renewable energy project from concept to completion 
 Competitive market rates 
 2/2 or 2/1 roster during construction (subject to project requirements) 
 Collaborative, high-performing project delivery environment 
 
 If you're an experienced Project Manager looking to lead the delivery of a major renewable energy project from study through execution, we'd love to hear from you .      Apply Now      For a confidential discussion, please contact:      Shannon Bromfield  PERSOL Australia     Shannon.Bromfield@persolapac.com         

  Who we are  
 At  PERSOL , we connect people to meaningful work and growth.  With decades of experience and a future-focused mindset, we're here to support your career journey. We offer fresh opportunities, trusted guidance, and a people-first approach.

result.description:
On behalf of our client, we are looking for a full-time experienced Marketing Specialist.  

The role will be responsible for supporting the business in the development, execution, and delivery of marketing campaigns across the portfolio to maximise acquisition and retention of users and clients. The focus of the role is to manage and execute marketing campaigns that meet and exceed ROI targets for the marketing plan, whilst delivering on client campaigns and attracting new clients across the portfolio.

The daily duties and responsibilities include:
• Identify market opportunities and advise the leadership team on all marketing strategies and campaigns to reach target markets, expand company brand and promote services to new customers
• Showcase your creative side to produce and design all marketing collateral, including digital, video and print content, to be used across companywide communication
• Manage all social media platforms including, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn & YouTube, ensure all content is scheduled, brand-appropriate and aligns with company content pillars guidelines & objectives
• Conduct all research and analysis of data in relation to consumer patterns and preferences.
• Predict and develop collateral for current and future trends across all social media platforms and implement all appropriate findings
• Oversee the company website & blog, create and manage SEO initiatives and evaluate the effectiveness of existing strategies to provide recommendations for improvements
• Keep ahead of search engine algorithm updates and integrated marketing trends, perform competitor analysis and collate findings into actionable recommendations
• Take ownership of creating interesting and brand-appropriate copy across social media, email communications, client-related content, marketing & blog content

Education – Bachelor degree or higher qualification desirable. Industry experience may substitute.

Experience & Skills 
• 2+ years of related experience
• Hands on experience in designing, building, launching and evaluating marketing plans, campaigns and programs
• Experience in digital marketing techniques and the optimisation of digital content across channels
• Excellent verbal and written communication
• Knowledgeable on Microsoft CRM
• Strong attention to detail when working with data
• Effectively manage events to be on time and budget
• Knowledge of marketing technology trends.
• Advanced computing skills including Microsoft Office applications, databases
• Passionate with a creative and pragmatic outcomes-driven approach
• Excellent stakeholder engagement skills
• Able to multi-task and work under tight deadlines

Salary - Salary being offered is commensurate with qualifications and experience and is between $80,000 - $100,000
